Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein the desiccant is selected to enhance the thermal stability of the gas generator composition.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, for further enhancing the thermal stability of the gas generating composition.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, providing enhanced thermal stability.

Claim 4 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, wherein the extrusion aid contributes to the overall performance stability of the composition.

Claim 5 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 4, wherein said extrusion aid is selected from graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof to improve the processing characteristics of the composition.

Claim 6 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

Claim 7 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, which contribute to the energy release characteristics of the composition.

Claim 8 (Currently Amended): The gas generator of claim 1, wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, which is used for its improved thermal stability properties in the gas generating composition.

Claim 13 (Currently Amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, wherein the desiccant is included to enhance the thermal stability of the composition. 

Claim 14 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13, wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13, wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13, wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide to optimize the performance of the composition.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13, wherein said desiccant is zeolite to improve adsorption performance in the gas generant composition.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The composition of claim 13, wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours, enhancing the stability of the composition over time.
